18:38.meaning: Nectar at first from sense-contact, poison at last — that joy is passionate.

18:39.meaning: Befogging at first and last, born of sleep, sloth, and error — that joy is dark.

18:40.meaning: Nothing on earth or in heaven stands free of nature's three moods.

18:41.meaning: Priests, warriors, merchants, laborers. Each has work assigned by inborn nature.

18:42.meaning: Calm, restraint, discipline, purity. Patience, honesty, wisdom, experience, faith. The priest's work.

18:43.meaning: Valor, fire, resolve, skill. Never fleeing battle. Giving. Commanding. The warrior's work.

18:44.meaning: Plowing, herding, trading — the merchant's work by nature. Serving — the laborer's work.

18:45.meaning: Loving one's own work, one reaches perfection. Hear how duty-done becomes perfection-won.

18:46.meaning: Worshipping through duty the source of all, the all-pervader — one reaches perfection.

18:47.meaning: Your own flawed duty beats another's perfect one. Doing nature's task incurs no sin.

18:48.meaning: Never drop inborn work, flaws and all. Every enterprise carries flaws, as fire carries smoke.

18:49.meaning: Self-ruled, detached everywhere, want-free. Through surrender one wins. Freedom from action itself.

18:50.meaning: Hear briefly how the perfected one reaches the ultimate. Wisdom's highest crown.

18:51.meaning: Pure intellect, self mastered by resolve. Senses set aside. Likes and dislikes dropped.

18:52.meaning: Lonely haunts, little food. Speech, body, mind restrained. Ever meditating. Desire renounced.

18:53.meaning: Ego, force, arrogance, craving, anger, possessions — shed. Mine-less, tranquil — fit for oneness.

18:54.meaning: One with the ultimate, serene — no grief, no craving. Same to all beings. Highest love for Me.

18:55.meaning: Through love one knows Me truly — how great I am. Knowing truly, one enters Me.

18:56.meaning: Doing all acts sheltered in Me, by My grace one wins the eternal, imperishable home.

18:57.meaning: Offer every act to Me in thought. Hold Me highest. Mind on Me always through steady focus.

18:58.meaning: Mind on Me — cross every danger by My grace. Refuse through ego — and perish.

18:59.meaning: 'I will not fight' — vain resolve. Your own nature will drag you to war.

18:60.meaning: Bound by your own duty-born nature, helpless, you will do what delusion refuses.

18:61.meaning: The Lord sits in every heart, spinning all beings round as on a machine by His power.

18:62.meaning: Surrender to Him wholly. By His grace find supreme peace and the eternal home.

18:63.meaning: Thus I have told the most hidden wisdom. Think it through fully — then act as you will.

18:64.meaning: Hear once more My highest word. You are dearly loved — so I speak your good.

18:65.meaning: Mind on Me. Love Me. Serve Me. Bow to Me. You shall reach Me — truly promised, for you are dear.

18:66.meaning: Drop every duty-code. Take Me alone as refuge. I will free you from all wrongs. Do not grieve.

18:67.meaning: Never tell this to the harsh, the faithless, the closed, or the scoffer.

18:68.meaning: Who shares this supreme secret with My lovers, loving Me deeply — reaches Me, doubt-free.

18:69.meaning: None serves Me more dearly among humans. None ever will.

18:70.meaning: Who studies this holy dialogue offers Me wisdom's own sacrifice. So I hold.

18:71.meaning: Who listens faithfully, without scoffing, is freed — rising to the worlds of the good.

18:72.meaning: Did you hear with focused mind? Is ignorance-born delusion gone, Arjuna?

18:73.meaning: Arjuna said: delusion gone. Memory regained by Your grace. Doubts fled. I stand ready. I will do Your word.

18:74.meaning: Sanjaya said: thus I heard this wondrous, hair-raising dialogue of Krishna and the great-souled prince.

18:75.meaning: By Vyasa's grace I heard this supreme mystery of devotion. From Krishna Himself. Lord of discipline. Speaking in person.

18:76.meaning: Remembering this holy dialogue again and again, O king, I rejoice endlessly.

18:77.meaning: Remembering Hari's awesome form again and again — great is my wonder, and my joy.

18:78.meaning: Where Krishna leads and Arjuna strives. There stand fortune, victory, prosperity, and justice.
